study type: Predictive Model Development and Validation Study
cohort: The study included all liveborn term singleton infants without congenital anomalies who were not admitted to the NICU in the province of Alberta.
finding: The developed prediction models for 7-day neonatal readmission following vaginal and cesarean births using routinely collected administrative data had sub-optimal performance (c-statistics 0.62-0.69) for use in risk assessment at discharge.
mod_finding: Separate prediction models were developed for vaginal and cesarean births, with readmission rates of 3.3% and 2.1% respectively, both demonstrating sub-optimal performance, though different predictors were excluded from the final models for each mode.
birth_weight: N/A (birthweight was evaluated as a predictor, but no specific weight range for inclusion in the cohort was mentioned)
